	allowed = { always = yes }
	enable = {
		check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 25 }
		NOT = { tag = MLK }
		country_exists = MLK
		NOT = { has_war_with = MLK }
		NOT = { has_wargoal_against = MLK }
	}
	abort = { always = no }
	ai_strategy = {
		type = prepare_for_war
		id = MLK
		value = -50
	}
}

zin_path_dark_forts = {
	# From the Gathering Dark's third tier (50): realms bordering a dark power build more stone forts.
	allowed = { always = yes }
	enable = {
		check_variable = { var = global.zin_gathering_dark value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
		any_neighbor_country = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
	}
	abort = { always = no }
	ai_strategy = {
		type = build_building
		id = bunker
		value = 50
	}
}
zin_path_grey_ford_gnw = {
	# CP03: the Grey Ford feud is a border war; neither side tries to conquer the other before the War of the Last Crowns.
	allowed = { original_tag = GNW }
	enable = {
		has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
	}
	abort = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
	ai_strategy = {
		type = conquer
		id = GIR
		value = -1000
	}
}

zin_path_afrit_parim_aen = {
	# CP24: the false god's realm, returned from the east, marches on the holder of Parim (Aenor).
	allowed = { always = yes }
	enable = {
		OR = {
			zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
			zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
		}
		has_global_flag = zin_afrit_returned
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
		NOT = { tag = AEN }
		any_state = {
			OR = {
				zin_is_site_parim = yes
				state = 1019
			}
			controller = { tag = AEN }
		}
	}
	abort = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead }
	ai_strategy = {
		type = conquer
		id = AEN
		value = 150
	}
}
